mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_info (company_name, business_number, ceo_name, address, phone) VALUES (#{companyName}, #{businessNumber}, #{ceoName}, #{address}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_name, business_number, ceo_name, address, phone, created_at FROM company_info ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE company_info SET company_name = #{companyName}, business_number = #{businessNumber}, ceo_name = #{ceoName}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone} WHERE id = #{id}
